tools.name: get_chip_location
tools.description: Use this when the person asks where the chip is in a passport or ID card, or why their iPhone does not read it. Give the country as a two-letter code or its English name. Not for whether a document is genuine: only the Superpass app reads and checks a chip. Answers where the chip is in that country'
